task: Read-only audit of the complete UTF-16 compiler migration; no source/fixture edits or compilation/browser execution
minimalCorrectContract: Every arbitrary JavaScript-origin string in the compiler semantic domain is Text (owned UTF-16 units) or a borrowed unit slice: source CSS, candidate raw/value/modifier/property/selector/variant payloads, AST strings, theme keys and values, CSS/source excerpts and emitted error messages. ASCII enum discriminants, fixed registry labels and validated numeric syntax may remain ASCII Rust strings; this exception must be proved at each boundary.

Logical text byte quotas use Text.byte_len (scalar UTF-8 bytes plus three bytes for each lone surrogate), allocator quotas use Text.owned_bytes and collection capacity, and JavaScript indexing/source coordinates use units().len. Existing Text.len returns logical byte_len, so String-to-Text replacement cannot preserve an indexing algorithm mechanically.

Candidate/variant ordering must explicitly compare UTF-16 units and port JS numerical run comparison; Text.Ord intentionally preserves scalar/code-point order and must not become the upstream JS comparator. Lookup equality uses exact unit sequences. Theme.entries preserves explicit insertion order, including overwrite/reset/default behavior.

Core JSON transport retains the existing string-shaped wire schema using the Text codec directly; decoding through serde_json::Value/String before Text is forbidden for arbitrary strings. Direct JS ingress reads JsString code units, direct output uses fromCharCode chunks. No replacement characters, synthetic CSS escaping, sentinel symbols or alternate re-encoding of source/candidates.

Public AST/DesignSystem currently use serde_json::Value, which cannot contain lone surrogates. Replace that domain with typed public AST/Candidate/Variant structures using Text, or a lossless JSON value tree whose String and object-key variants are Text and whose object order is retained. Undefined, BigInt, Arc array/node/Source and cached JS object identity must remain separate from textual encoding.

Errors preserve Text messages in serialized/native/JS fields; Debug/Display for logs cannot serve as the source of the official error message. Error source excerpts concatenate original unit slices. CSS/source spans and translation maps count UTF-16 units exactly once.

Serde tagged enums containing arbitrary Text require direct typed field decoding, not the derived Content-buffering Deserialize path. Preserve tag/wire schema and field-order independence; typed payload strings and object keys must reach Text directly even inside nested variants. See serdeTaggedEnumSupplement for the observed CompileError RED/GREEN and unverified AST/public-value risks.

The original name was absent during this audit; the renamed log contains the actual failure, so its earlier green-looking filename is not evidence of success.
serdeTaggedEnumSupplement.observedFailure: After Syntax.message became Text, serde_json::from_str::<CompileError> of the serialized error failed with unexpected end of hex escape. The error JSON roundtrip assertion was reached before the exact oracle message-unit comparison.
serdeTaggedEnumSupplement.mechanism: Serde 1.0.229 internally tagged enum deserialization collects non-tag values through ContentVisitor into Content before decoding the selected variant. Content stores JSON strings as scalar Rust String/str, so the Text field codec does not directly consume the original JSON string token. Merely changing a field from String to Text does not remove this buffering boundary.
serdeTaggedEnumSupplement.observedRepair: CompileError keeps the existing internally tagged Serialize wire shape, but its custom Deserialize reads a typed Fields struct directly, including message: Option<Text>, then selects the fixed ASCII Kind. The recorded tests cover 18 fixed function-error message-unit cases with typed error JSON roundtrip, the existing other error variants, and a syntax object whose message precedes kind.
serdeTaggedEnumSupplement.requiredContract: Every serde tagged enum that will contain arbitrary Text must decode fields directly through typed structs or a lossless typed visitor, including nested enum payloads. Retain the existing tag/wire fields and permit field order independent of kind; do not stage through Content, scalar serde_json::Value/String, or another buffering derive that consumes strings before Text. Add exact isolated-unit, nested-payload, reordered-field and scalar wire regressions for each migrated domain.
